lines.text: AMC ten challenge! Think it's one third? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 10 challenge! Think it's 1/3? Nope!

lines.text: An ant starts at corner C. Each second, it crawls a random edge.
lines.caption: An ant starts at corner C. Each second, it crawls a random edge.

lines.text: What's the chance it reaches E before A?
lines.caption: What's the chance it reaches E before A?

lines.text: Look at the front face. A and E are opposite corners.
lines.caption: Look at the front face. A and E are opposite corners.

lines.text: Spin the prism half a turn. A and E swap, and so do C and F!
lines.caption: Spin the prism half a turn. A and E swap, and so do C and F!

lines.text: Same prism! F racing to E is like C racing to A.
lines.caption: Same prism! F racing to E is like C racing to A.

lines.text: That means f equals one minus c.
lines.caption: That means f equals 1 minus c.

lines.text: Use the corner rule, and eleven c equals four. That's four over eleven!
lines.caption: Use the corner rule, and 11c equals 4. That's 4/11!

lines.text: Did you get four over eleven? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 4/11? Tell me below!
